description: Controls for authorizing, monitoring, and controlling the delivery and removal of system components are not implemented.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing authorization procedures for equipment delivery/removal, lack of chain-of-custody documentation, absence of receiving/shipping logs, inadequate inspection procedures for incoming equipment, missing inventory reconciliation processes, and no evidence of controls to prevent unauthorized removal of equipment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Physical and Environmental Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
